import React, { useState } from 'react'; import { Search, MapPin, Calendar, Ticket, CreditCard, User as UserIcon, Info } from 'lucide-react'; export default function User({ user, activeTab }) { const [from, setFrom] = useState('Dhaka'); const [to, setTo] = useState('Cox\'s Bazar'); const [date, setDate] = useState('2026-08-10'); return (
{/* 1. HOME TAB (Default view for User.js) */} {activeTab === 'home' && ( <>

Hello, {user.name} 👋

Where would you like to travel in Bangladesh?

Search Bus Tickets

setFrom(e.target.value)} style={styles.input} />
setTo(e.target.value)} style={styles.input} />
setDate(e.target.value)} style={styles.input} />

Your Upcoming Bookings

No active bookings found for {date}.

)} {/* 2. ABOUT TAB */} {activeTab === 'about' && (

About Online Bus Bangladesh

Online Bus Bangladesh is the leading digital bus ticketing portal in Bangladesh. We connect major divisions including Dhaka, Chittagong, Sylhet, Khulna, and Rajshahi with top operators like Green Line, Hanif, and Ena Transport.

)} {/* 3. PROFILE TAB */} {activeTab === 'profile' && (

Passenger Profile

Contact ID: {user.emailOrPhone}

Account Type: Passenger Account

)} {/* 4. PAYMENT TAB */} {activeTab === 'payment' && (

Payment Options & Wallet

Rocket Wallet
Credit / Debit Card
)}
); } const styles = { container: { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '20px' }, subText: { color: '#a1a1aa', marginTop: '-12px' }, card: { backgroundColor: '#27272a', padding: '24px', borderRadius: '16px', border: '1px solid #3f3f46' }, flexTitle: { display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '10px', marginBottom: '12px' }, searchGrid: { display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr))', gap: '16px', margin: '16px 0' }, inputBox: { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '6px' }, label: { fontSize: '0.75rem', fontWeight: '700', color: '#a1a1aa', textTransform: 'uppercase' }, field: { display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px', backgroundColor: '#18181b', padding: '10px 14px', borderRadius: '8px', border: '1px solid #3f3f46' }, input: { background: 'none', border: 'none', color: '#ffffff', outline: 'none', width: '100%', fontSize: '0.9rem' }, actionBtn: { display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', gap: '8px', width: '100%', backgroundColor: '#ea580c', color: '#ffffff', padding: '12px', border: 'none', borderRadius: '10px', fontWeight: '700', cursor: 'pointer' }, emptyState: { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center', padding: '32px', color: '#a1a1aa', gap: '8px' }, infoGroup: { display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: '12px', color: '#e4e4e7', fontSize: '1rem', marginTop: '16px' }, paymentMethods: { display: 'grid', gridTemplateColumns: 'repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr))', gap: '12px', marginTop: '16px' }, methodCard: { backgroundColor: '#18181b', padding: '16px', borderRadius: '10px', border: '1px solid #3f3f46', textAlign: 'center', fontWeight: '600' }, };
